page.notes: Doubtful readings: "dedasq;" in XII is set oddly in the print and may be read differently. "hodie" in X may carry a grave accent that is hard to see. The last word of XVI, "gotium", is set right-aligned on its own line and is read as the completion of "ne-", so "negotium". No printing errors were corrected; "Scriberem" and other forms are as printed.
